ticks.note: Tick 1 enters S. Its only transition is a delayed self-loop, so nothing is computed yet and every output still has its initial value.

pick = 20; guarded = 3. keep = B ? 5 has no else part: it keeps its current value (1) when B is false. The ternary binds tighter than + and its three parts must be simple (a literal, a name or a parenthesised expression): sum = B ? 10 : 20 + 1 means (B ? 10 : 20) + 1 = 21. nested = 3. (The inner condition needs its own parentheses, (A > 2), for the reason shown in ternary-binds-tight.)
